AI will erase the entire game developing field. In 2027 a single person (a common gamer) will be able to make any game he wants to play using AI for less money than buying a new game. AI will erase the movie industry (not the cinemas). By 2028 anyone will be able to have AI make whatever movie they want to watch. This will be the same for cinemas, they will be able to make whatever movie the specific location's demographics wants to see, and they will keep all the profits (AI can't replace the big screen experience, it can replace everything that is needed to make a new movie). AI will erase software developers. Current models are already better than 99.9% of human developers (the 0.1% is the only part that innovates, the others are just copy-pasting), it is much faster much cheaper. The same is true for artists and designers. The ones that will keep their job are those doing live performances that are not directly tied to economic growth (performers like singers, dancers, theater actors, sports players), because people will chose to pay for these performances as their hobby. Everything that is required for the society to run and the civilization to progress, will be done by AI (and robots).
